context.transcript:
Hi, Xinyu. How was the budget meeting this morning?
Well, it was a long meeting, but the board of directors
finally agreed that we don't have enough employees.
Finally that's good news. We're getting lots of
new clients, and we need people to work on their
accounts. By the way, the possible logo designs for
the Jefferson account were just sent over from the art
department. Want to come to my office to look at
them?
I have to go to another meeting right now.
OK, well, we have until next week to provide
feedback.
context.transcript_translation:
你好，欣瑜。今天上午的预算会议怎么样？
嗯，会议开了很久，不过董事会最后终于同意我们的人手不够。
终于有好消息了。我们接到了很多新客户，需要人来负责他们的账户。对了，美术部刚刚把杰斐逊客户项目的几款标志设计发过来了。想来我办公室一起看看吗？
我现在得去参加另一个会议。
好的，不过我们到下周之前都还可以提供反馈。
